description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useFinanceSummary' which fetches and normalizes financial data for UI display. It includes a helper function 'normalizeFinanceSummary' to process the payload from the API into a stable, UI-friendly format.

methods.name: normalizeFinanceSummary(payload)
methods.description: Processes raw financial payload into a stable, UI-friendly object, handling null/undefined cases and ensuring proper data types.

methods.name: useFinanceSummary()
methods.description: Custom React hook that fetches financial summary data from the backend API endpoint '/finance/summary' and returns the data along with loading and error states.
